items.item_text: Certified Clinical Transplant Dietitian (CCTD)certification.
Certified Nutrition Support Clinician (CNSC)certification.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Dietitians must possess the equivalent of a Bachelor's Degree in Foods and Nutrition/Dietetics and have completed an Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics internship.
A Master's Degree in Nutrition.
Two (2) years’ experience with experience in comparable Transplant Hospital/acuity level.
Prior experience working with Heart and/or Lung transplant patients.
Must possess the experience, skills, knowledge, and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.

Under supervision of the Department of Transplant, the RDN (dietitian) assumes total responsibility, in the outpatient (clinic) setting, for the nutritional care of all pre, waitlisted and post-transplant patients. Assesses pre-transplant nutritional needs, develops and implements nutritional care plans, reports results as appropriate.

Provides education on nutrition for patients and family members regarding disease specific need. Monitors long-term progress. Participates in various transplant meetings and committees. Serve as resource person on nutritional care of the pre- and post-transplant patient. Develops, implements and records in EHR the nutrition care plan for all assigned patients. Continuously evaluates and monitors the effectiveness and outcomes of medical nutrition therapy intervention. Actively participates in medical rounds. Participates in department's special projects, performance improvement activities, and research.

Provides nutrition lectures and in-services to nutrition and medical staff as assigned. Collaborates with and mentors dietetic interns/students. May provide coverage for the other solid organ transplant services in the absence of the primary dietitian following all duties as outlined in the primary RD's job summary.
Registered Dietitian (RD).
Bilingual: English/Spanish.
Must work effectively with all levels of staff, physicians, patients and external constituents.
Must have proven independent thinking, decision making, problem solving and prioritizing skills.
Knowledge of ICU/Critical Care needs.
Must possess excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of Cystic Fibrosis care needs.
Excellent ability to multi-task with demanding time frames.
